messages:
Lena Park: opened a quick docs PR to add an "alerting" subsection under console observability. it covers cost-anomaly alerts, dashboard thresholds, and an example Alertmanager receiver. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/904 — pinging for quick review.
Omar Farouk: nice. can we include a sample PromQL alert rule for sudden spike in per-token cost? that helps customers get to a working alert fast.
Vikram Rao: suggest a simple rule: 
```yaml
- alert: TokenCostSpike
  expr: increase(redwood_token_cost_usd_total[5m]) / increase(redwood_tokens_total[5m]) > 0.002
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Per-token cost spike for {{ $labels.model }}"
```
Lena Park: perfect, I'll add that. also adding a short section on choosing thresholds (percentile baselines vs fixed limits).
Omar Farouk: could we also show an Alertmanager receiver example that posts to the Console's incident channel? small snippet: 
```yaml
receivers:
  - name: 'console-incidents'
    webhook_configs:
      - url: 'https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/webhook?channel=incidents'
```
Vikram Rao: add a note about rate-limiting on the webhook and recommend batching alerts.
Lena Park: added both. one more ask: include a tiny Go SDK example that tags spans with a cost and emits a metric via OpenTelemetry so customers using Go have parity with Python/JS snippets.
Vikram Rao: here's a Go example you can paste:
```go
tr := otel.Tracer("redwood.example")
ctx, span := tr.Start(context.Background(), "generate")
span.SetAttributes(attribute.Key("redwood.cost.token_usd").Float64(0.00095))
defer span.End()
// use meter to record metric
m := global.Meter("redwood")
counter, _ := m.Float64Counter("redwood_token_cost_usd_total")
counter.Add(ctx, 0.00095, attribute.String("model", "redwood-4"))
```
Omar Farouk: looks good. also add a short troubleshooting section: common causes of noisy alerts (clock skew, aggregate scrape intervals, and synthetic load from CI).
Lena Park: added troubleshooting + a short checklist for migration: update dashboards, add alert rules, verify webhook permissions. I also fixed a stale link to the Dashboard JSON schema (link fix).
docs-bot: Preview build is up: https://deploy-preview-904--docs.redwood.ai/ :white_check_mark:
alerts-bot: Test alert sent to console-incidents receiver (preview sandbox). check https://sandbox-904-redwood-inference.internal/alerts for payload.
Omar Farouk: tiny nit on wording: change "alert on cost" -> "alert on cost per-token or deviation from baseline" to be clearer.
Lena Park: done, pushed. planning to merge after one more review from docs or SRE. thanks! :memo:
